attacks.name: 30th Century Arsenal
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If the defender is within |!range| 2, this character may reroll 1 die in the attack roll.
|!wild| |*Future Tech|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§bleed§Bleed|, |§hex§Hex|, or |§slow§Slow|.

attacks.name: Neuroshock Field
steps: After each attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

attacks.name: The Once and Future Kang
steps: This character may reroll any number of attack dice for this attack.

superPowers.name: The Kang Dynasty (Affiliation: Cabal)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, each allied character may reroll 1 die in its attack roll. Additionally, allied characters can modify and reroll |!failure| results while they are holding or Contesting an objective token.

superPowers.name: Anti-Gravity Device
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Temporal Rewind
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking or defending, at the end of the |*Modify Dice| step or after the |*Temporal Rewind| |!reactive| superpower has been resolved, this character may use this superpower. The attacking and defending characters reroll all their attack and defense dice.

superPowers.name: Neurokinetic Chronal Armor
superPowers.body: At the start of this character's Activation, it may Place itself within |!range| 1 of its current position, remove up to 1 |!damage| from itself, or remove up to 1 special condition from itself.|\|Additionally, the first time each Turn that this character rerolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power|.
